subject: planner: enable non-prepared plan cache for dml (#60325)
summary: This commit flips the default of @@tidb_enable_non_prepared_plan_cache_for_dml to ON (via vardef.DefTiDBEnableNonPreparedPlanCacheForDML), making DML (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE and SELECT ... FOR UPDATE) eligible for non-prepared plan cache when the main non-prepared plan cache switch is enabled. Planner-side cacheability checks and plan-cache machinery already handle DML (range rebuild includes Insert/Update/Delete; partitioned tables still require dynamic partition pruning; privilege checks still run on cache hit). No Blocker/High correctness/semantics/privilege/transaction issues found, and upstream/master keeps this default enabled (no later revert/fix indicating a regression).
